localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
Group site includes one covered picnic shelter, two water spigots, with a vault toilet and coin operated showers nearby. One RV is allowed on the parking pad, 50 Amp connection available. Tents must stay within the Group Site area. Parking for 7 vehicles maximum (including one RV).
Parking outside the group site needs Ranger approval and subject to additional fees.

This site is ADA only. Only people with disabilities may reserve ADA sites. Proof of eligibility must be provided to park staff when you check in at the park.
Cut off date for making reservations at the Lake Spokane campsites is 11:59pm the day before arrival.

Large Family Campsite will allow 12 people. NO SEWER, WATER, OR ELECTRICITY AT THIS CAMPSITE.
